usedFor: New Stripe customers are tagged in your MailChimp audience.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Add Tags to Audience Member” in MailChimp
bestTemplate.why: A tag keyed on the email lets you segment paying customers from everyone else.

watchOut: “Add Tags to Audience Member” finds people by email, so the address must already be in MailChimp.
